audience: University senior management and faculty administrators.
purpose: Provide senior academic leadership with overview of student enrollment, graduation outcomes, language requirement compliance, and attrition reasons to support strategic planning.
questions: How many students are currently enrolled and how has this number changed year‑over‑year?
What proportion of students graduate each year and is the trend improving?
Are students meeting English and HSK language requirements, and are there changes over time?
What are the main reasons for student attrition and how significant are they?
How does the attrition rate compare to the overall student population each year?

kpis.name: Total Students
kpis.limitations: Assumes student_id uniquely identifies each student; dataset covers only selected faculty.

kpis.name: Graduation Rate
kpis.formula: AVG(CASE WHEN is_graduate='Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
kpis.limitations: Rate calculated as percentage of students marked as graduate; missing or ambiguous values treated as non‑graduate.

kpis.name: English Requirement Compliance
kpis.formula: AVG(CASE WHEN english_requirement_status='Met' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
kpis.limitations: Binary status assumed; records with null treated as non‑compliant.

kpis.name: HSK Requirement Compliance
kpis.formula: AVG(CASE WHEN hsk_requirement_status='Met' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
kpis.limitations: Three possible statuses; only 'Met' counted as compliant.

kpis.name: Attrition Rate
kpis.formula: AVG(CASE WHEN resign_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
kpis.limitations: Only 10 records have resign_reason; rate may be unstable due to small sample size.
